eyebrow: Search for Common Ground · Imagine If: Balloons · New York, Aug 2026 · One-voice short
title: Imagine If:
headline: Kind is not the same as nice: a stranger says she does not fake it, she puts herself in your shoes.
story: A young woman in a New York park says it straight: I'm not nice. I'm kind. She loves people, she does not fake it, and she puts herself in the other person’s shoes.
That is the client’s idea in one person: real respect between people who are different. Then she and her friends let the balloons go. Inspiring, not generic. One person, about 25 seconds.
do: Open on frame 1 with Destiny speaking and “NOT NICE. KIND.” on screen.
Keep it about Destiny only. GV gets his own video later.
Show the sign once, long enough to read (the release row does it).
Stop the last bite at “it will”.
Cut from the MXF. Match the look and pacing of the approved Balloon Release montage.
dont: Not about New York, karma or religion. Not about balloons as a toy.
Do not use her wish line 3:03.3–3:10.3. The montage already uses it.
No name super. No place name.
No animation in the middle (Kalindi: “it was inauthentic”).

tech: Picture: 764 MXF files, 16:9. The Monday brief says 1920×1080, 23.98 fps. Our probe could only read the proxies (960×540, 23.976 fps, several mono audio tracks). Check the MXF in the NLE before you set the timeline.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps. Same as the source. No conversion.
A 9:16 crop of 1080p is 608 px wide, so it is already upscaled 1.78×. Keep punch-ins at 110% or less. Sharpen lightly. In the close shots GV is on the left: crop right on Destiny.
Audio is in the camera. The MXF has several mono tracks. Solo each track and use the one with the clear voice. We did not measure the channels here.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Any music 18–20 dB under the voice.
Royal-blue box #1E6FD6, white text, floating over the speaker. Max 2 lines. Keep the bottom 20% clear.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file. 9:16 only. Deliver to Frame.io → Ready for Review.

The sign is readable for at least one second.
No name and no place name on screen.
